name: min_eig_path_4
description: 4x4 SDP: min <C,X> s.t. tr(X)=1, X 4x4 PSD, C = tridiagonal Toeplitz T_4(2,1) (diagonal 2, off-diagonal 1). By the variational formula opt = lambda_min(C) = 2 + 2 cos(4*pi/5) = 2 - 2 cos(pi/5) = (3 - sqrt(5))/2 = 0.38196... Optimal X* is the rank-1 projector onto the BOTTOM eigenvector (singular, boundary optimum). Exercises the minimize (maximize=0) objective path (bead arb-prec-IPM-n1x).
reference_method: Closed form lambda_min(T_n(2,1)) = 2 + 2 cos(n*pi/(n+1)); n=4 -> 2 - 2 cos(pi/5) = (3 - sqrt(5))/2. Cross-checked in mpmath (mp.dps=80) against 2+2*cos(4*pi/5) to < 5e-71.
